claims.claim: FAILURE projections preserve typed integer/null exits, phase, subject, source digests and safe causes while rejecting unsafe public material and leaving private originals unchanged.
Dirty candidates support artifact-only FAILURE transport and existing terminal attention without publishing a candidate ref; transport failures expose typed blockers.
BP-2 diagnostic contexts retain source identity, typed causes and actionable guidance with run_created=false and executor_invoked=false.

Exact RUN identity is enforced. Attention, fresh Brain Sync and provider context carry safe source-bound diagnostics. Both implicated regression cases pass implementation-local checks with their assertions retained.
The authorized local reader returns original private FAILURE and capture bytes after workspace, RUN, subject, locator and digest checks, explicitly representing missing captures.
Synthetic regressions cover timeout/null exit, 23 dirty entries, transport, attention, provider handoff, private access, BP-2, replay, quoted pytest selectors and privacy/integrity rejection.
The common admitted policy defaults to 180 response minutes and a bounded 185-minute watchdog across all nine supported provider/operation dispatch combinations.

Incomplete V2 observations retain original identities and digests with explicit incompleteness and unavailable fingerprints. Malformed records receive precise blockers; prospective V1 failures retain private evidence identities and capture digests.

Both advisory sources were independently SHA-256 validated and consumed in the required order after candidate, scope and baseline checks. Changes occupy only 27 permitted paths; historical artifacts, attribution logic, TASK r6 and its five ordered V1 commands remain unchanged.
